title: News edition
description: Written each morning by the news agent to ~/agent-house/desks/news/news.json (with a copy in editions/YYYY-MM-DD.json) and read by The Desk. Check it with `npm run validate-news` in the-desk repo. On top of this schema the validator also checks: fewer than 3 stories needs a note saying why; story ids are unique across stories and more; ranks are unique across the edition; dates are real calendar days; every link is a whole https:// link that opens the site it shows (plain ASCII site name, not an IP address), with no user name or password; a story never lists the same page twice.

edition.description: Date of the edition, Toronto time

note.description: Anything Snow should know about today's edition. Required (not empty) when there are fewer than 3 stories: say why.

stories.description: The top 3 stories. Fewer only with a note saying why.

more.description: Up to 7 more stories for the shelf, in the same shape.

id.description: Short id, unique in the edition, e.g. s1

rank.description: 1 is the most important, up to 10; unique across stories and more

date.description: When it happened as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty when unclear

summary.description: Two or three sentences in the agent's own words

why.description: One line on why it matters

skeptic.description: The strongest fair critique or open question

sources.description: The pages used, each a different page: at least 2 independent ones and at most 8 (if more were used, keep the 8 strongest)

name.description: The publication or site, e.g. Reuters
